_comment: Verbatim /State reads from three real appliances on one household LAN,
2026-08-22/23, each paired with what Home Assistant's cloud Miele integration
reported for the same appliance at the same moment. Nothing is synthesised.
Underscore-prefixed keys are provenance, not appliance fields.
The two dishwasher captures are the pair that solved remote start: identical
Status, RemoteEnable and ProgramType, one write refused and one accepted.
StandbyState is the difference, confirmed as cause by a controlled A/B.
The dryer captures show the opposite split: it takes DOP2 and ignores /State,
where the EK057s 404 every DOP2 leaf and take /State.

dishwasher_g7369._note: mid-cycle. Cloud reported mobileStart on across this window.

washer_wwi860._note: Status 4 on a plain delay, not armed. ProcessAction 1 here was accepted and ignored - Status 4 alone does not mean startable.

dryer_twl780wp._note: program selected but not armed; door open.

dishwasher_g7369_armed._note: ARMED but ASLEEP (StandbyState 2). The write is acknowledged and ignored. Compare dishwasher_g7369_started_ok.
dishwasher_g7369_armed._programtype_note: backfilled from recorder history; this unit only ever reports 0

dryer_twl780wp_delay_not_armed._note: Panel read 'RemoteStart possible' while the mobile-start bit was 0 - the panel advertises the capability, not the arming. Later started fine via DOP2.

dishwasher_g7369_started_ok._note: The one that WORKED, over /State, on firmware with no DOP2 at all. Differs from the armed-but-asleep capture only in StandbyState and ProgramPhase.
